text_block_list.text:
First place in the Satsuki Sho slips
through Narita
Brian's fingers. Realizing
her shortcomings, she
resolves not to
lose next time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Although she doesn't take first, her
performance
still impacts the other
racers. The press dubs her
"the Beast" in
the ensuing articles.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан, however, is completely
focused on
her next goal—the Japanese
Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
